**CONDITIONS**

**1. Insured's Duties After Loss**

In case of a loss to covered property, you must see that the following are done:

a. Give prompt notice to us or our agent.

b. Notify the police if a law may have been broken.

c. Give us a description of the damaged property, showing the quantity, kind, and value. Do not throw away any damaged property until it has been examined by us or our representative.

d. Take all reasonable steps to protect the covered property from further damage. If you take reasonable steps, we will pay for reasonable costs incurred in doing so. Keep a record of these expenses for us to examine.

e. Prepare an inventory of damaged personal property, showing the quantity, description, actual cash value, and amount of loss. Attach all bills, receipts, and related documents that substantiate the figures you report.

f. As often as we reasonably require:

(1) Show us the damaged property.

(2) Provide us with records and documents we request and permit us to make copies.

(3) Submit to examination under oath, while not in the presence of any other insured, and sign the same.

g. Send us a signed, sworn proof of loss within 60 days after our request. This proof shall state, to the best of your knowledge and belief:

(1) The time and cause of loss.

(2) The interests of all insureds and all others in the property, including all liens and encumbrances.

(3) Other insurance that may apply to the loss.

(4) The actual cash value and amount of loss for each item of damaged property.

(5) Any changes in title, use, occupancy, or possession of the covered property during the policy period.

(6) The location of the covered property at the time of loss and the names of any occupants.

**2. Duties of the Mortgagee**

If a mortgagee is named in this policy, we will pay for covered loss to buildings or structures to the mortgagee as their interest may appear. The mortgagee has the right to receive loss payment even if the mortgagee has started foreclosure or similar action on the covered property. If we deny your claim because of your acts or because you have failed to comply with the policy terms, the mortgagee still has the right to receive loss payment if the mortgagee:

a. Pays any premium due under this policy on demand.

b. Submits a signed, sworn proof of loss within 60 days after receiving our request.

c. Has notified us of any change in ownership, occupancy, or substantial change in risk of which the mortgagee is aware.

If we pay the mortgagee for a loss and deny payment to you, we are subrogated to all rights of the mortgagee to recover the full amount of the mortgagee's claim. We may pay the mortgagee the amount due on the mortgage and receive a full transfer and assignment of the mortgage and all securities held as collateral.

**3. Cancellation**

You may cancel this policy at any time by returning it to us or by giving us advance written notice of the date cancellation is to take effect.

We may cancel this policy by mailing or delivering to you written notice of cancellation at least:

a. 10 days before the effective date of cancellation if we cancel for nonpayment of premium; or

b. 30 days before the effective date of cancellation if we cancel for any other reason.

Delivery of written notice to you, or mailing of written notice to you, at the mailing address shown in the Declarations is sufficient proof of notice. We will refund the excess of premium paid beyond the pro rata premium for the expired policy term. The refund is not subject to a short rate cancellation penalty. The refund will be made as soon as practicable after the cancellation becomes effective. If the reason for cancellation is the nonpayment of premium, we may cancel the policy for a past-due amount at any time before the loss occurs.

**4. Changes**

This policy contains all the agreements between you and us concerning the insurance described here. No one can change this policy except by an endorsement issued by us that is made a part of this policy. No waiver or change of any term of this policy is valid unless it is in writing and signed by one of our authorized representatives. If we waive a right under this policy on one occasion, that waiver does not mean we waive that right on any other occasion.
